records.title: ILCM Community Impact Fund – Africa
records.deadline: 15 November 2026 (closing time and timezone not published)
records.eligibility: Africa-based patient organisations, community organisations and grassroots advocacy groups addressing liver cancer or liver disease.
records.summary: Community-led liver cancer projects. Download the application form and email it with a budget and timeline to grants@ilcm.global.
records.notes: Official call explicitly accepts applications. The linked PDF returned HTTP 200. Submit the completed form by email.

records.title: Joint Innovation Facility Circularity Call
records.deadline: 29 January 2027 pre-screening. Invited proposals due 28 February 2027 (closing times and timezones not published)
records.eligibility: Revenue-generating circular businesses in eligible African countries, operating at least three years, leading a consortium with an EU-registered for-profit partner.
records.summary: Milestone-based non-dilutive funding for plastics or electronics circularity. The African lead must be registered in Ethiopia, Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique, Namibia, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, South Africa or Zambia.
records.notes: Current official call gives revised January and February dates. The linked Good Grants portal returned HTTP 403 to a direct fetch and a JavaScript shell to web browsing. Intake remains unconfirmed.

records.title: Microsoft AI Economy Institute Cohort 4 research funding
records.eligibility: Researchers worldwide affiliated with accredited universities or research institutions. Principal investigators need a PhD or equivalent terminal degree.
records.summary: Research funding for work on AI and jobs. Up to two principal investigators per proposal.
records.notes: Current official call provides the opening date and invites submissions. The cohort-specific linked login portal returned HTTP 200.

records.title: FBIS Africa Freshwater Biodiversity Data Mobilisation Small Grants
records.deadline: 9 November 2026 (closing time and timezone not published)
records.notes: Funder explicitly invites African data holders. Linked DOCX returned HTTP 200. Complete the form and email it with the project leader’s CV to nazley@frcsa.org.za, subject FBIS-Africa small grant application submission.

records.title: Creatives For Our Future 2026
records.notes: Official application page explicitly states the intake window and links to the current CFOF 2026 form, which returned HTTP 200.

records.title: CODESRIA Research Grants on University Ecosystems
records.deadline: 16 January 2027 (closing time and timezone not published)
records.notes: Current official call solicits proposals from researchers affiliated with recognised African institutions. Official submission URL reached the CODESRIA login with HTTP 200.
